    Validate and standardize a weights matrix (canonical SCM weights)

    validate_weights_matrix.Rd

    Canonical format:

    • rows: all units in the panel (unit ids) in a known order

    • cols: treated units (treated ids)

    • entries: donor weights for each treated unit (0 allowed)

    validate_weights_matrix(
  W,
  require_dimnames = TRUE,
  nonneg = TRUE,
  allow_self_weight = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    W

    Numeric matrix of weights.

    require_dimnames

    Logical; require row/col names.

    nonneg

    Logical; require nonnegative weights.

    allow_self_weight

    Logical; if TRUE, allows treated unit row to be nonzero.

    Value

    A validated numeric matrix.
